observations.footwork: Small bouncing motions, maintaining a stable orthodox stance
observations.guard: Both hands held high, elbows tucked, protecting the face
observations.upper_body: No significant movement; relaxed ready posture
observations.distance: Fighting distance from the pads held by the trainer on the right
observations.notable: Trainer holding green focus mitts, waiting for the exchange

observations.footwork: Lead foot steps in, rear foot pivots, then step back to reset
observations.guard: Right hand extends forward during the strike, left hand remains in guard
observations.upper_body: Torso rotates left, shoulders turn significantly as right arm punches out
observations.distance: Closes distance quickly to strike, then retreats away from the pads
observations.notable: Fighter throws a straight right punch (cross), full extension visible

observations.footwork: Small shuffles to reset and re-establish stance
observations.guard: Both hands returned to the high guard position
observations.upper_body: Slight sway, back to a calm ready position
observations.distance: Distance maintained, slightly larger than the striking range earlier
observations.notable: End of the exchange, fighter returns to a neutral fighting stance

movement_events.detail: Fighter steps forward and loads the right hand before throwing
Fighter extends the right arm forward, rotating the torso to deliver a straight punch
Fighter retracts the right hand back to guard and steps back to reset
Fighter creates space from the trainer after the combination
